name: avegancafe
description: Kyle's personal Claude plugin: a home for one-offs that don't warrant their own plugin. Ships the work-notes-vault skill (his private Obsidian work vault and its Granola meeting archive), the side-quest skill (offers to hand tangential findings to a named `claude --bg` session in its own worktree, so the main session stays on task), and a session-title mod that keeps session titles in `type(Scope): imperative summary` form, refined as the work grows.
